picks.editorial_note: The first-ever use of AI-designed bacteriophages to treat a patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection marks a landmark translation of generative AI from the lab bench to a real clinical intervention.
picks.title: This time, the virus is on the patient’s side. AI helped design it

picks.editorial_note: A $334 million Schmidt Sciences grant to NCSA for a new supercomputing system is one of the largest single AI-infrastructure investments of the year, dramatically expanding national research computing capacity.
picks.title: NCSA Joins the Schmidt Science Computing Network to Expand Advanced Computing for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: UC Berkeley and Berkeley Lab's parallel entry into the Schmidt Science Computing Network, establishing the Berkeley Science AI Platform at NERSC, shows the same mega-initiative building out multi-institution, government-lab-scale AI compute capacity.
picks.title: UC Berkeley, Berkeley Lab collaboration with Schmidt Science Computing Network will Provide High Performance Computing for Cutting-Edge Research - NERSC: National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center

picks.editorial_note: A £39 million UKRI investment funding 20 Turing AI Fellows at Edinburgh represents a major national-scale bet on AI research talent and capability in the UK.
picks.title: Turing AI Fellows set to strengthen UK’s AI capability | News | The University of Edinburgh

picks.editorial_note: The acquisition of Imperial spinout Cogitat by Indivi for its brain-wave foundation model is a concrete market validation of university AI research converting into commercial neurotech value.
picks.title: Imperial spinout Cogitat acquired by Swiss startup Indivi for its brain foundation model

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's new Center for Marine Intelligence and its AI4Coral partnership with KAUST pairs AI and robotics with marine science for automated coral reef monitoring, a cross-border, cross-disciplinary research partnership with direct environmental stakes.
picks.title: HKUST Establishes Center for Marine Intelligence and Partners with KAUST to Launch Inaugural AI4Coral Research Project
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's FemtoMind project applying agentic AI to lattice QCD calculations is a notable push to accelerate fundamental particle physics research using novel AI methods under the national Genesis Mission effort.
picks.title: FemtoMind advances Genesis Mission at the proton scale

picks.editorial_note: A systematic review by MIT CSAIL and 15+ institutions cataloguing 95 scenarios for AI-driven catastrophic risk is a significant contribution to the policy conversation on AI safety governance.
picks.title: Researchers find eight ways AI could lead to our downfall

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge-led analysis finding a third of the global AI supply chain is invisible to government oversight has direct implications for AI export controls and national security policy.
picks.title: A third of the global AI supply chain is ‘invisible’ to governments

picks.editorial_note: A further $19 million Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund grant to Texas Tech for an AI-integrated computing cluster strengthens the state-level push to build domestic semiconductor and AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: Texas Tech Receives $19 Million Grant to Further Semiconductor Innovation | Texas Tech Now
